text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Daaaaaaargh--!! 
...Phew! *pant*... *gasp*..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"(Seriously... what am I supposed to do? 
My head's such a mess, I can't stand it 
unless I'm running!)"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Good work, Hishi Ama-san. 
May I run with you?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, Flower! You're working hard this 
late. 
Of course you can! Alright, let's run 
together!"

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaah--!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Heheh! Not bad! You've been getting 
stronger at an incredible pace! 
Alright, one more lap!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Ama-san... does it make you happy 
that I'm getting stronger?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Well, of course! The more strong runners 
there are, the better. 
Going toe-to-toe with tough rivals is what 
gets the blood pumping!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"The closer you get to someone strong 
ahead of you, the more you can truly feel 
yourself growing stronger, right? Nothing 
makes me happier than that!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Keeping that in mind makes me wanna put 
everything into training. 
Getting stronger day by day is just plain 
fun!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"You really don't hesitate for a single 
second, do you, Hishi Ama-san? 
You're incredible. Always charging 
straight ahead... truly amazing."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"What brought this on? Flattery won't get 
you anywhere, you know!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"No, it's just how I honestly feel. Maybe 
it's so second nature to you 
that you don't even realize it, but..."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"I think people are able to 'keep trying' 
because beyond all the pain, 
there's a joy or a dream so immense that 
it blows all that suffering away."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, despite knowing that, people 
quickly 'forget,' don't they? 
No matter how much they love it, or how 
desperately they want to achieve it."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"I'm the same—I want to run, I want to 
win, and I'm trying my hardest, 
but it's just one hardship after 
another... and despite all the struggle, 
the results don't follow..."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"There were so many times my heart almost 
broke, wondering, 
'Why am I putting myself through something 
so painful?'"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"But when your efforts are rewarded, all 
of that pain just vanishes. 
And every single time, I think, 'Ah, I'm 
so glad I worked hard.'..."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"—Every day is a repetition of that. 
That's why I can truly see just how 
incredible you are, Hishi Ama-san."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...and the feeling when the immediate 
pain makes you forget your true dream, and 
you just can't keep trying anymore..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Forget... huh. I see, that's why those 
two...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Heh... I guess I'm just too 
simple-minded. That kind of feeling never 
really clicked with me... so I couldn't 
understand them."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"It's not like they grew to hate racing or 
designing. If anything... it hurts 
precisely because they're taking it so 
seriously."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. It hurts because it means so much to 
them. No one stresses over things they 
don't care about."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Those two must have dreams they want to 
grab hold of, too... After all, they've 
devoted their whole lives to this."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm...? Wait, doesn't that mean... They 
only forgot, but the passion is still in 
their hearts...?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Then...! All we gotta do is remind them! 
Bring back their passion for their true 
dreams!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Big Sis Hishi Ama is gonna show 'em... 
what's waiting on the other side of that 
wall!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Man, I'm so bored out of my mind... 
Wait... what am I even doing coming out to 
a place like this...?"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"—Hishi Ama-san! Keep fighting!! 10 
seconds left! 8, 7, 6...!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Haaaaaaah!! I'll break it, I'll break 
through! I'm gonna break right through my 
own limits!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Limits...? What's Hishi Ama-senpai even 
doing?"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"She's challenging a 'new record.' Trying 
to shave off a whole second from her 
personal best—"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
She wants to show you both what it looks 
like to overcome an insurmountable wall.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"O-One whole second?! Off her personal 
best?! That's a difference of five or six 
lengths! That's just completely 
reckless..."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. That is precisely why Hishi Ama-san 
set the goal of 'one second.'"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "—Alright! Flower! What's the time?"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"So close. You were 0.2 seconds short. But 
looking at your average time, it's 
definitely shrinking bit by bit!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"I knew it, having someone to overtake 
brings out your best, right? Next run, 
I'll pace with you!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Sounds good! I'm counting on you, 
Scarlet!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"I mean... take a look over there. We 
didn't even need to ask her to come 
watch... What a simple-minded idiot."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Say what she will, she just can't keep 
racing off her mind. Hehe...! Come on, 
let's put on a show for her!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "Yeah! I'll remind her with how I run!"
